text: The doc store answers

The systems of record answered
The SOW is filed — everything downstream derives from it and cannot be invented
The requirements are filed
They are filed as supplied, not paraphrased — everything downstream cites them and cannot tell a summary from the source
The product brief is published
Every feature the SOW commits to is covered or named out of scope
The design library is published
It links the real artifact — the Figma file or component library — rather than describing it
The timeline is published
Every milestone has a date and something it delivers
The roster is published
Every role a later phase assigns work to has a named holder
Roles left deliberately unstaffed are recorded with a reason
Roles and responsibilities are published
Every named holder appears against at least one responsibility
The features are published
Every feature names the outcome it is betting on
Every feature says how it will be judged — the target, and where the number comes from
What the brief leaves unclear is an open question, not a guessed feature
The epics are published
Every epic belongs to a feature
Every epic traces to something the brief or the SOW commits to
Every epic names the milestone it serves
What the brief leaves unclear is an open question, not a guessed epic
The delivery plan is published
Every role the plan names is staffed on the roster
The foundation architecture is published
Every epic has a named home in the architecture
Ways of working is published
This sprint's plan is published
Every committed story belongs to an epic
Every committed story is on the board with an owner
The plan fits the roster's capacity, or says where it does not
Work taken on that was not in the plan is recorded as unplanned

The retro is published

The research is published
Every constraint names where it came from — a system, a document, or a person who said it
What could not be found out is listed, not left as a gap the architecture quietly fills
The review is published
Every finding says what it would cost to be wrong about
A review that found nothing says so explicitly, rather than being an empty document
The research is accepted by the principal engineer, and their name is on the close
The architecture is published
Every decision names what it beat and why — an option not considered is not a decision
Every constraint the research surfaced is either honoured or explicitly overruled
The review is published
Each decision is judged against the research, not against the reviewer's preference
Disagreements are recorded as findings the approver can rule on, not resolved privately
The architecture is accepted by the principal engineer, and their name is on the close
Every finding from the review is answered — accepted, actioned, or overruled with a reason
The scaffold record is published
What was created is listed with where it lives, so it can be checked rather than trusted

The review is published

The scaffold is accepted by the principal engineer, and their name is on the close
